summary: The newest visible arXiv listings after the 2026-09-07 announcement emphasize coherent vector-meson photoproduction in hadronic PbPb collisions, EIC-ready saturation and DIS event-shape observables after hadronization, relativistic-hydrodynamic boundary conditions, and validation-centered AI/ML tools for detector simulation and nuclear-code execution. The strongest entries are experimentally or phenomenologically actionable; the main caution concerns broad phase-transition language in clustering nuclei without enough abstract-level evidence for robustness.
strongest_paper: CMS coherent J/psi photoproduction in hadronic PbPb collisions is the strongest heavy-ion result; the eHIJING saturation observable study and the differentiable IceCube photon-propagation surrogate are the strongest phenomenology and AI/ML transfer entries.

papers.title: Spin-dependent azimuthal asymmetry of coherent J/psi photoproduction in hadronic PbPb collisions at sqrt(sNN) = 5.36 TeV
papers.abstract: CMS measures the azimuthal asymmetry of muons from coherently photoproduced J/psi mesons relative to the second-order event plane in hadronic PbPb collisions at 5.36 TeV using 1.26 nb^-1. A negative A2 = -0.194 +/- 0.022 stat. +/- 0.018 syst. is observed with significance above five standard deviations, with no strong rapidity or overlap dependence, and is consistent with photon-polarization inheritance by the vector meson.

papers.title: Heavy Flavors and Quarkonia at RHIC
papers.short_authors: Cameron Dean, Xin Dong, Rongrong Ma, Cesar Luiz da Silva
papers.abstract: A review of PHENIX and STAR open-heavy-flavor and quarkonium measurements at RHIC, focused mainly on 200 GeV collisions, covering production, cold nuclear matter effects, R_AA, elliptic flow, charm baryon-to-meson ratios, quarkonium suppression, and future RHIC/EIC connections.

papers.title: Spectator shadowing as the source of the breaking of NCQ scaling at RHIC-FXT and FAIR energies
papers.abstract: The authors propose that spectator shadowing can explain the observed breaking of number-of-constituent-quark scaling in low-energy identified-hadron elliptic flow, using an idealized quark-coalescence source and ballistic Glauber spectator model.

papers.title: Thermal boundaries for relativistic fluids without a conserved charge
papers.short_authors: Lorenzo Gavassino, Soeren Schlichting, Gabriel S. Denicol
papers.abstract: A kinetic-theory derivation of boundary conditions for an ultrarelativistic, no-charge fluid between thermally conducting plates. The walls act as modified absorbing boundaries, not thermostats, and the corresponding hydrodynamic initial-boundary-value problem is proved well posed.

papers.title: Tracing Gluon Saturation through Hadronization at EIC
papers.short_authors: Weiyao Ke, Xu Liu, Yu Shi, Xin-Nian Wang, Jian Zhou
papers.abstract: Using eHIJING with nonlinear small-x initial-state radiation, beam remnants, final-state radiation, and hadronization, the paper finds that parton-level nuclear kT broadening is diluted in several conventional hadronic observables, while global hadronic recoil remains sensitive and can be unfolded toward the underlying hard-scattering kT distribution.

papers.title: Hadronization effects and electroweak contributions in DIS one-jettiness
papers.short_authors: Radja Boughezal, Haotian Cao, Zhong-Bo Kang, Xiaohui Liu, Sonny Mantry, Frank Petriello
papers.abstract: The paper derives leading hadronization effects and massive electroweak contributions for tau1 and tau1a DIS one-jettiness, showing universal shape-function structure with calculable kinematic dependence and presenting high-accuracy QCD plus electroweak predictions compared to Pythia for HERA/EIC kinematics.

papers.title: FUSION: a skill-based research agent for publicly obtainable nuclear-physics codes
papers.abstract: FUSION uses code-specific skills to obtain, run, parse, and benchmark public nuclear-physics codes before reporting results. The current release covers 20 codes spanning nuclear reactions, structure, fission/statistical models, R-matrix analysis, astrophysics, and heavy-ion transport, plus an offline nucl-th literature collection.

papers.title: A Differentiable Neural Surrogate for Photon Propagation in Neutrino Telescopes
papers.short_authors: Felix J. Yu, Berthy T. Feng, Nicholas Kamp, Carlos A. Arguelles
papers.abstract: candela is a differentiable SIREN neural field for IceCube photon Green's functions, predicting yield and arrival-time distributions for point deposits and sensors. It reports 50-100x faster event generation, median yields within 2% of Monte Carlo, timing agreement at the MC statistical floor, and end-to-end gradients for event and medium parameters.

papers.title: Quantum Graph Neural Networks for Jet Tagging on Quantum Hardware
papers.short_authors: Benjamin Jobilal, Jinghong Yang, Trevor Smith, Vincent Calvo, Zhong-Bo Kang, Shabnam Jabeen
papers.abstract: A permutation-invariant quantum graph neural network is applied to particle-cloud jet tagging for quark/gluon and up/down discrimination. Ideal simulations are reported as competitive with Particle Flow Networks and QCD observables, scaled-down models are run on IBM and IonQ hardware, and interpretability connects learned features to generalized angularities and jet charge.

papers.title: FluxDisco: Symbolic Regression for Stoichiometric Dynamical Systems via Monte Carlo Graph Search
papers.short_authors: Cassandra Durr, Alvaro Koehn-Luque, Chris Jewell, Lloyd A. C. Chapman
papers.abstract: FluxDisco constrains symbolic regression for flux-based stoichiometric ODE systems using known stoichiometry, reducing the search space and enforcing physical adherence while adapting Monte Carlo Graph Search for joint flux discovery.

papers.title: A Data Fusion Framework for Grounding Aerospace Surrogate Model via Experimental Wind-Tunnel Observations
papers.short_authors: Nitin Nagesh Kulkarni, Dheeraj Vemula, Yin Yu, Peter Lyu, Juan J. Alonso
papers.abstract: A CFD-trained surrogate is corrected with spatially registered wind-tunnel pressure measurements, learning systematic simulation-to-experiment discrepancies without retraining the base surrogate and improving held-out pressure-field agreement.

cautions.title: Signals for Nuclear Solid-Liquid Phase Transition in Clustering Nuclei
cautions.short_authors: Xi-Guang Cao, Yong-Hao Jin, Chun-Wang Ma, Wen-Bo Liu, Yu-Gang Ma
cautions.abstract: The paper claims a new first-order nuclear solid-liquid phase transition in low-energy heavy-ion collisions of clustering nuclei, with negative heat capacity, caloric plateaus, fragment and entropy signals, and melting-like pair-distance distributions.
